name: church
description: A stone parish church: a long nave on a plinth with stepped buttresses between tall pointed (lancet) windows, a steep slate roof between coped gable parapets with a cross and a rose window at the east end, and a square west belfry at the +Z end with corner piers, string courses, a pointed doorway with steps, clock faces, paired louvred belfry openings, a parapet with corner pinnacles and an octagonal slate spire with lucarnes and a gilded cross.
